summary: Brazil Potash Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a public offering of 3.7M common shares at US$2.50/share and 18.3M pre-funded warrants at US$2.499/warrant, plus full exercise of the underwriters' option for 3.3M additional shares. Net proceeds were US$59.3M for working capital and general corporate purposes. The offering was made under an effective F-3 registration statement. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other event-driven category applies. The lock-up agreement and pre-funded warrant mechanics are standard. No further action or risk-arb angle exists.
